t: The DEWALT ToughSystem 2 storage tower offers robust and secure tool storage, ideal for demanding construction sites and workshops. Built from durable polypropylene, this weather-resistant system features an IP65 water and dust seal, safeguarding tools from harsh conditions. The tower incorporates easy-to-use latches for module connection and buckled lids with lockable plastic clamps for security. An extendable handle and two rear wheels facilitate convenient transportation of up to 70kg across job sites. This system includes DS165, DS300, and DS450 boxes, and is compatible with existing ToughSystem components. Ideal for tradespeople needing reliable mobile organisation.
